description.en: Pull requests in your sidebar, kept live: title, repo, lines changed, checks and review. Choose which to show (this workspace's branch, yours, the ones that mention you or want your review, or a saved search) and click one to open it. It stays off until you turn it on.

tagline.en: A live list of pull requests with checks and review, in your sidebar

scopes.integration:github:read: Read pull requests, their checks and reviews through your GitHub sign-in, private repositories included. Your token stays in cmux; this app never sees it.
scopes.workspace:read: Follow which workspace is selected, to show its branch's pull request.
scopes.git:read: Read the selected workspace's branch and GitHub repository.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a browser tab when you click it.
scopes.clipboard:write: Copy a pull request's link when you pick Copy link.
scopes.workspace:write: Check out a pull request in a new workspace when you pick it.

optionalScopes.net:api.github.com: Without a GitHub sign-in, read public repositories through GitHub's public API.
